summary: Layer 1B expansion found four US-listed or US-exchange candidates tied to transformer-adjacent component chokepoints. The strongest underfollowed mapping is not a pure transformer OEM, but upstream/adjacent inputs: grain-oriented electrical steel for transformer cores, transmission-line hardware that must be procured before grid construction, utility bushings/arresters/connectors, and smaller magnetics/power-component suppliers. Evidence is strongest for product exposure; evidence is weaker for direct supplier relationships into large power-transformer OEMs, so most names remain hypotheses or inferences for later verification rather than promoted conclusions.
